subject: Re: Localized creative for 420 BrightBite locations
body:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for reaching out, the timing is good. We're planning a national menu launch in Q1 and our franchisees keep asking for local versions of the ads. Right now each regional version takes our team weeks.

Could we set up a 30-minute call next week? Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon works for me. I'd like our CFO, Ken, to join for the second half.

Best,
Maya

subject: Re: Dynamic creative for your restaurant pitch
body:
Hi Daniel,

Interesting, but our budget is locked until Q1. Also, we pay our current vendor a flat fee and I'm worried your pricing would be higher. Can you send me your rate card so I can compare?

Sam
